say:1:1534421001:0.text: Black-green vines coiled like serpents. Soon, the warrior was lost. But she remembered the Great Priestess' words when she left:
say:1:1534421001:0.source_cn: 黑绿的藤条交错，勇士一时迷失了方向。她想起了临走时大巫...

say:2:1534421002:0.text: <style="highlight">"Take the small boat and seek the shrine. At the entrance to the sacred dwelling lies a lone wooden island in the lake—that is where the treasure awaits.</style>

say:3:1534421003:0.text: Children, think. Where could the treasure be?
say:3:1534421003:0.source_cn: 孩子们，用你们的智慧好好想一想，宝藏究竟在哪里？
